qualified_hardware: MPC Live II + full X-Touch MC/USB
prior_image_acceptance: r4: flashed over r3 on MPC Live II, booted, upgraded into the r4 stage, replaced the boot helpers, connected the controller and played the heavy project cleanly; r3 and r2 earlier confirmed flash, boot and projects.
runtime_acceptance: r5 mouse support on the owner's Live II, run in the r4 stage: cursor with no manual step after a boot with the mouse attached and after hot-plug, clicking and drag-select, and the wheel as the focused control's data wheel over tracks and presets at slow and fast speeds. The r4 heavy-project repair is retained and unchanged: no clicks with eight concurrent faders, unplug/reconnect and Drum Mix on the project that clicked with r3.
image_acceptance: r5: flashed over r4 on MPC Live II on 2026-09-15, booted, installed the r5 stage, replaced the boot helpers, kept the r4 stage; on the flashed build the cursor appeared at boot and after hot-plug, click and drag-select worked, the wheel drove tracks and presets, and the heavy project played cleanly with the X-Touch connected. Known limit: a fast wheel spin on some sliders (volume) overshoots.
